foundationWeight.scope: Physical RC cap/grid union only. All material is below source portalDPC; it cannot precompress that cut. Pile shafts, slab, superstructure and soil are excluded.
foundationWeight.loadAllocation: Disjoint cap material acts at its same named head with preserved moments; remaining source-beam material uses its own finite Timoshenko member, including transverse eccentricity. No new support or fixed reaction is inserted.

courtCornerClosure.scope: Explicit formed source corner quarter replaces the missing physical footprint. Lower contact and body gravity charge eccentric forces/moments to the actual shared frame node; its rigid joint-plane assumption, local torsion/shear/cage and construction remain unqualified. No new restraint, soil support or adopted material proof.

straightDevelopment.policy: No hook/cover/confinement reduction is credited; source poor-bond comparison retained.

uniformThickeningConsequence.scope: Uniform-known-domain upper-bound quantity comparison only; no local band geometry or changed stiffness solve.

floorReinforcement.recommendation: Retain RC200 as a floor candidate. Develop conventional straight continuous bars with explicit edge/void anchorage; the failed vertical-return template is not a proof that the slab is impossible. Do not uniformly thicken the slab from this screen. Resolve the specific short edge routes with a physically drawn, force-level conventional anchorage and rerun altered material/stiffness if its body changes.
